title: Opening of the 1959 interview and name
summary: Crawford and Allen identify themselves, give the date and address, and Mello says he is called Manny.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: And this is Richard Allen. Manny J. Mello. We're recording this afternoon of August the 3rd, 1959 at 1025 Betholome Street. So we've got your name on there. You call yourself Manny?
Manny J. Mello. That's what they always did call me. But Manuel is your father. Manuel is your father.
